reviews.text:
After being told by Greg that our job was so small, with 6 windows and a screen door, and that they really weren’t going to make any profit, he ended up being a no call no show for our estimate appointment. We used this company around 27 years ago and thought we would give them repeat business, not now and would give zero stars if I could.

Update to owners response: You are right, Greg did give us an off the top of his head “guess” on how much it might cost. That was not “an over the phone “quote”, and that is when he said it was a small job and ya’ll would make little profit!
None of that really matters, the problem is in the fact that he was a no CALL no show, until after I posted the google review. The appointment was for 9am-10am on Wednesday 12/10/25. We called him the first time at 10:12am with no answer and left a message, then we called again at 10:31am with no answer and left another message, stating that we no longer needed his services. We got a text, not a call, at 11:39am asking if he could come out the following morning from 9am-10am. I did not respond to the text, because we left a voicemail stating that we no longer needed his services, therefore the statement that he could not get there until 10:30 on Wednesday is false!
It wasn’t until Thursday 12/11/25 at 11:09am, that he called to try and come out again.
We have text and voicemail time stamps, that’s why we have specific times stated.
We understand that he had a personal emergency with his dog, but this a business and being stood up for an appointment is unprofessional. It is our belief that our job was too small to be a priority! “Someone” should have called to cancel, or reschedule the appointment, before the scheduled time came and went.
reviews.author: Donnie R

reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about Atlas Solar-Tex. Back in April 2021 we got a quote. It wasn’t the cheapest but it wasn’t the most expensive. I read reviews and decided to give the go. Then a storm passes through the area giving golf ball size hail. This storm caused 3 new windows to be installed. Insurance claim + shortage of supplies caused delay for my solar screens. This company is so understanding and willing to work with my schedule. They pushed it out each week for the next and followed up to see if there was an ETA. I appreciated the follow up. 3 months later after finally everything was completed I was able to get my solar screens. They look fabulous and I couldn’t be more happy.
reviews.author: Jennifer McGlothlin

reviews.text: Best deal in town for solar screens.  Atlas Solar-Tex did a great job installing solar screens on my house.  The total process took less than a couple weeks.  The screens looks really nice and the pricing was affordable.
reviews.author: Scott D

reviews.text: We contacted Mr. Chad McGhee from Atlas Solar-Tex for the entire installation of custom made 90% black solar screens for our home. The price for the screens was extremely reasonable and well worth the purchase in helping our home become more energy efficient. The installation of the screens was fast and efficient and now our house is much cooler in the summer and warmer in the winter. The screens are high quality materials and they add great curb appeal to our home as well. We highly recommend getting your custom made solar screens from Atlas Solar-Tex. Great service, prices, and products. Thank you!
reviews.author: Sammer Suleiman

reviews.text: We love our new Solar Screens!  Not only do they look amazing but we are saving a ton of money on our electric bill.  THey keep the house much cooler and my floors are no longer fading.  Great company great service, great prices
reviews.author: Leslie Alexander

reviews.text: The screens look wonderful and make a huge difference with the heat. We put a fixed and sliding screen on our sliding glass door. It makes a huge difference when the sun is on that side of our house. The screens are quality and were installed nicely. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Leslie McFarland

reviews.text: If I could leave zero stars I would. Horrible customer service. Never returns calls. Won’t come to look at the screens that were installed INCORRECTLY. Literally the worst company. Save your money and go elsewhere
reviews.author: stephanie worley

reviews.text: Very pleased with our screens! Excellent quality and installation and great prices.
reviews.author: Valerie Neill

data.summary: Reviews show authentic customer experiences with clear patterns of both satisfaction and frustration. The company appears to be a legitimate long-established business (31 years) with generally good service but occasional communication and reliability issues. The Yelp/Google discrepancy warrants caution but doesn't indicate widespread fake reviews.
fake_signals: Large Yelp review count (57) vs Google (12) for same business
Yelp rating (4.9) significantly higher than Google (4.3)
Some Google reviews are very old (9-10 years)
authentic_signals: Specific details in positive reviews (project types, timelines, crew names)
Negative reviews contain specific complaints with names and details
BBB shows 31 years in business with A+ rating
Mixed feedback includes both praise and criticism
data.discrepancy_explanation: Yelp shows 4.9 with 57 reviews while Google shows 4.3 with only 12 reviews. This suggests either different customer bases or potential review manipulation on Yelp given the significant volume difference.
